text: Decided, from the last critique: (1) show that a pause never kills by starting a real child process (for example a sleep) registered as a line's running job, driving the watcher to a pause on that line, and asserting the process is still alive and its registry entry unchanged; drop the step that runs go on a job already dispatched. (2) Read each job's forecast cost p90 from its reading's forecasts and pass it to the T3 check, so T3 can pause; fix the plan's text that says p90 is unused.
